source.name: S.S. Lazio - S.S. Lazio and kaiyunsports.news announce a two-season partnership
source.quote: the kaiyunsports.news logo will appear on the sleeve of the S.S. Lazio Men’s First Team jersey

source.name: Lazio Style Store - Lazio Maglia Gara Home 2026/27 (official club store product page)
source.quote: Realizzata da Mizuno nell'iconico colore sky blue, reinterpreta uno dei grandi classici della storia del Club
source.note: date precision: year; the product page carries no publication date. The club's homepage partner wall (sslazio.it) also lists Mizuno as Ausrüster-equivalent kit supplier.

change.text: Lazio start 2026-27 with a blank front: Polymarket signed in April, Italy's ADM blacklisted it in July, and the club terminated in August. kaiyunsports.news took the sleeve on 22 August.

summary: Serie A. No front sponsor: Polymarket signed in April 2026 and the deal was terminated on 11 August, before the season began. kaiyunsports.news is the sleeve sponsor (Serie A matches, 2026/27 and 2027/28); the kit maker is Mizuno. Every placement checked against the club's official kit renders and store photos: only the sleeve carries a sponsor.
